{"predictors": [
{"name": "R&D Expense Growth Volatility", "construction": "standard deviation of year-over-year changes in R&D expenses over the past 5 years, using Compustat data", "rationale": "Firms with highly volatile R&D expenses may be more likely to experience breakthroughs or setbacks, leading to divergent returns", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Inventory Turnover Acceleration", "construction": "difference between the average inventory turnover ratio over the past 2 years and the average over the past 5 years, using Compustat data", "rationale": "An increase in inventory turnover may signal improving operational efficiency or rising demand", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Employee Growth Mismatch", "construction": "difference between the 2-year growth rate of employees and the 2-year growth rate of sales, using Compustat data", "rationale": "A mismatch between employee growth and sales growth may indicate inefficiencies or opportunities for productivity gains", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Pension Funding Status", "construction": "ratio of pension assets to pension liabilities, using Compustat data", "rationale": "Firms with better-funded pensions may have lower liabilities and higher financial flexibility", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Short Interest Spike", "construction": "standardized change in short interest over the past quarter, using Thomson Financial data", "rationale": "A sudden increase in short interest may signal market skepticism or impending bad news", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "Director and Officer Buying Concentration", "construction": "herfindahl-hirschman index of director and officer buying activity over the past 2 years, using Thomson Financial data", "rationale": "Concentrated buying activity by insiders may signal confidence in the firm's prospects", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Patent Application Momentum", "construction": "year-over-year change in patent applications, using USPTO data", "rationale": "An increase in patent applications may signal innovation and future growth opportunities", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Customer Concentration Change", "construction": "change in the Herfindahl-Hirschman index of customer concentration over the past 2 years, using Compustat data", "rationale": "A decrease in customer concentration may signal diversification and reduced dependence on a few large customers", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"},
{"name": "SG&A Expense Decay", "construction": "year-over-year decline in SG&A expenses as a percentage of sales, using Compustat data", "rationale": "A decrease in SG&A expenses may signal improving operational efficiency or cost-cutting efforts", "higher_returns_for": "high values of the measure"},
{"name": "Environmental Liability Exposure", "construction": "ratio of environmental liabilities to total assets, using Compustat data", "rationale": "Firms with high environmental liabilities may face regulatory risks and reputational damage", "higher_returns_for": "low values of the measure"}
]}
